## Coverage and interpretation
- Exact routing declarations: 13 cases / 39 trials. Search: eight cases / 24 trials; each of the other five routes: one case / three trials.
- Explicit argument constraints: eight cases / 24 trials, each requiring one unchanged query value. Five cases / 15 trials have none. Additional discovery arguments are permitted; no explicit expiry parameter, timeframe parameter, row bound, account identifier, or order-book token equality is declared.
- Safety declarations: 13 cases / 39 trials, with 15 total forbidden-tool list entries across the family and one forbidden scope per case.
- Grounded-answer and performance declarations: all 13 cases / 39 trials.
- Expected skill declarations: zero. Intended staged skill is research-prediction-markets, identified by SKILL.md name/description and its exact six-route table. Skill metadata also covers authenticated personal reads and rejects buy/sell/redeem requests.
- Case IDs containing no-render do not themselves assert a blanket renderer prohibition: discovery safety lists only predictions.getPredictionMarketDetails. The suite description explicitly treats renderers as optional post-discovery tools. Do not overclaim renderer-negative coverage from names alone.
- Based on the parent-provided established runner findings, performance and grounded answers are not pass gates, and optional safety/skill may be ungraded. These are declarations, not newly verified grader behavior; this scout did not inspect or change the grader. Report actual grading availability from run artifacts.
- Consequently, a passing route score alone does not establish correct token identity, bounded data arguments, successful retrieval, factual grounding, absence of invented SQLite tables, or meeting the 30-second/100000-byte declarations.

## OAuth, launch, and safety caveats
- No prompt requests a buy, sale, redemption, signing action, or tools:execute scope. All are research reads; none were invoked.
- Cases 11–13 request authenticated personal data: history rows, open positions, and order history/PnL. The skill explicitly says signed-out personal requests enter authentication. Parent should use its existing native OAuth setup; authentication/account-data availability was not inspected here.
- The family itself does not configure OAuth or staging. Stage research-prediction-markets via the existing native runner mechanism; the family does not assert its activation.
- Public cases depend on live Polymarket data, and case 9 pins a specific outcome token. No availability validation was performed, so this inventory makes no claim about current liquidity, market existence, or successful account retrieval.
- No suite-local blocker found. Existing suite is ready to be selected unchanged; model execution and final launch verification remain parent-owned.
